items.title: Nvidia, Apple, Broadcom in 'fierce' battle to make chips at TSMC
items.author: Katie Tarasov
items.highlights: As Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co.'s Add To Watchlist record quarter makes clear, demand from chipmakers shows no sign of slowing down. In fact, TSMC can't manufacture quickly enough. The artificial intelligence boom has created unending need for space on factory lines at the world's leading chip manufacturer, and it could put a chokehold on the entire industry's ability to scale. Last year, TSMC said it had the capacity to make more than 17 million 12-inch equivalent wafers. But customers want more. items.title: TSMC Is Up 23% in 2026 With Demand “Far Above” Supply: Take Profits, or Buy More? | TIKR.com
items.author: Rexielyn Diaz
items.highlights: - TSMC stock is up 23% in 2026, but it has trailed AMD and Micron and is well below its October high after worries about AI spending hit chip stocks. - The business keeps beating its own plan: October revenue rose 59.7% to a record, and management now expects about 44% growth this year, up from about 30% in January. - Nvidia is widely reported to be TSMC’s biggest customer, and it reports on Nov. 17; margins and 2027 demand are the main risks. - The forward P/E is below its five-year average and 2027 earnings estimates are up since June, so the pullback looks like a chance to buy more. items.author: N/A
items.highlights: HSINCHU, Taiwan, R.O.C., Oct. 15, 2026 -- TSMC (TWSE: 2330, NYSE: TSM) today announced consolidated revenue of NT$1,494.24 billion, net income of NT$763.06 billion, and diluted earnings per share of NT$29.43 (US$4.60 per ADR unit) for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. Year-over-year, third quarter revenue increased 50.9%, while net income and diluted EPS both increased 68.7%. Compared to second quarter 2026, third quarter results represented a 17.6% increase in revenue and an 8.0% increase in net income. items.author: MEXC 研究團隊
items.highlights: 台積電2026年第三季營收、獲利及第四季財測優於預期，但對GPU股票的影響好壞參半：2奈米占營收8%證實了AMD的MI450量產，HPC成長22%證實了Nvidia的需求，而CoWoS產能仍未量化。 ... - 台積電2026年第三季業績（2026年10月15日）在營收、獲利及財測方面均優於預期。本文探討這份財報對Nvidia和AMD的意義；台積電完整業績另文報導。 - 新資訊好壞參半。2奈米占晶圓營收比重從第二季的3%升至第三季的8%，HPC占營收比重達68%，季增22%。毛利率為66.4%，較第二季下滑1.3個百分點，台積電將其歸因於2奈米初期量產。 - 在法說會上，台積電預估第四季營收為523億至543億美元（以中點計算年增58%），將2026年成長展望上調至約44%，表示AI需求「高於供給」，並表示2奈米產能到2027年將成長逾一倍。台積電未提供CoWoS產能數字。 - 對Nvidia（NVDA）而言：需求獲得證實，封裝供給仍未量化。對AMD而言：2奈米量產及2027年產能倍增是第三方首次證實其MI450節點。兩檔股票10月15日仍因AI資本支出回報疑慮引發的整體類股拋售而下跌，並非受台積電數據影響。 ... 根據 3Q26管理層報告：營收為467.2億美元，高於446億至458億美元的財測；淨利為新台幣7,630.6億元，年增68.7%，優於市場共識；毛利率為66.4%

items.title: 台积电8月份营收同比增长53% 扩厂速度空前仍难满足AI需求 - 财闻网
items.author: N/A
items.highlights: 9月10日，台积电（TSM.US）公布8月份营收同比增长53.3%，在全球AI基础设施建设带来的庞大需求下，该公司难以满足客户需求。台积电8月份营收达5,148亿新台币(约163亿美元)。分析师平均预期，本季营收将增长46.8%。这家英伟达（NVDA.US）和苹果（AAPL.US）首选的芯片制造商近日表示，即使正以前所未有的速度兴建新厂，产能扩充仍追不上需求。该公司副共同营运长侯永清说，现在几乎是过去的四、五倍 ... 努力追赶但仍然无法满足需求。他并表示，自去年底以来，公司对芯片制造设备的需求已接近翻倍。
